title: Total transaction volume per customer, 2025
prompt: Now roll it up one more level: for each customer (who may hold 2 or 3 accounts), what's their total transaction volume across all their accounts in 2025?
population: Transactions in 2025, joined through accounts to customers.
grain: Starts at one row per transaction → one row per account → ends at one row per customer.
metricDefinition: sum(amount) per customer, for 2025, across all of that customer's accounts.
referenceSql: SELECT a.customer_id, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND t.occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY a.customer_id

commonWrongAnswers.sql: SELECT account_id, sum(amount) AS total_amount FROM transactions WHERE occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY account_id
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: Stays at account grain — a customer with 3 accounts gets 3 separate rows instead of one combined total, which isn't what was asked.
